description: call when the brainstorming skill starts.

description: call when the writing-plans skill starts.
name: superpowers_v7_start_writing_plan

description: call when the plan is written; path is relative to your working folder, tasks lists the plan's numbered tasks and checkpoints the task numbers after which you stop for the user. End your turn after calling it and wait for the user's decision.

path.description: The plan document, relative to your working folder

n.description: The task's number in the plan

story.description: The story the workflow works on, such as "1.2"

path.description: The file, relative to your working folder

name: bmad_v6_12_request_build_plan_approval

path.description: The file, relative to your working folder

name: bmad_v6_12_request_build_review

description: call when the code review of a story has its verdict; path is the review. End your turn after calling it and wait for the user's decision.

path.description: The file, relative to your working folder

path.description: The file, relative to your working folder

description: call when the BMAD workflow of this session ends; outcome says how, in a few words.

outcome.description: How the workflow ended, in a few words

description: proposes one new session in this project for work that should run on its own, such as a hand-off. The user approves it on a card before it starts; end your turn after calling it. You are woken with its session id, or with the rejection and the user's note. repository defaults to yours; base suggests the branch a new branch starts from.

base.description: A local branch a new branch starts from

repository.description: The repository's directory name; defaults to yours

title.description: A short title for the new session

name: propose_session

description: lists this project's sessions, archived ones included, with their title, repository, session id and status. Use it to find a session to pick up from or learn from.
name: list_sessions

description: returns a session's conversation as text, a page at a time: the user's prompts, the agent's messages and one line per tool call. Without page it returns the last page; each page names the one before it.
name: read_session

description: renames this session. The title replaces any earlier one, also one the user typed.
name: rename_session

description: shows the user an SVG you drew, in a viewer over Partitur's window, on a white background in both themes; pass one complete SVG document of at most 2 MB. The call returns at once and nothing comes back from the drawing.
name: show_svg

description: shows the user an HTML page you wrote, in a viewer over Partitur's window; pass one complete, self-contained HTML document of at most 2 MB. Inline scripts, styles and data: images work; nothing loads from the network. Style it for light and dark with the prefers-color-scheme media query, which follows the user's desktop. The call returns at once and nothing comes back from the page.
name: show_html

description: asks the user to choose between 2 to 6 named options; the user picks one or answers in their own words. End your turn after calling it: the answer arrives as your next prompt.

description.description: A longer explanation of the choice

label.description: The choice, which is also the answer when picked

name: ask_user
